data.name: payment.manualCard.checked
data.value: I checked the terminal: payment succeeded and the amount matches.

data.name: payment.manualCard.uncertain
data.value: If the result is unclear, check the terminal transaction history first. Do not charge again.

data.name: payment.manualCard.finalAmountRequired
data.value: Manual card must settle the full remaining balance. Clear the entered amount or enter the remaining balance.

data.name: payment.manualCard.orderChanged
data.value: The order or cashier changed. This confirmation cannot be used. Check the terminal payment and return to the correct order.

data.name: payment.manualCard.saveHint
data.value: Save this order before leaving. If saving fails, retry here. Do not charge again or close POS.

data.name: payment.manualCard.saveFailed
data.value: The confirmed payment could not be saved safely. Retry saving this same order.

data.name: payment.manualCard.refundUnavailable
data.value: Manual card payments cannot be refunded through a linked terminal.

data.name: settings.payment.methods.description
data.value: Choose the payment methods available on this POS. Save to apply your changes.

data.name: settings.payment.methods.manualCard.help
data.value: Off by default: use Credit/Debit Card. When on, Manual card replaces it and the cashier confirms payment on the standalone terminal.

data.name: settings.payment.methods.voucher.help
data.value: Off by default. When on, Voucher is available on the payment page.

data.name: payment.settings.loadFailed
data.value: Payment method settings could not be loaded. Return to the payment page to retry.

data.name: payment.settings.methodDisabled
data.value: This payment method is disabled in payment settings.

data.value: The cashier confirms payment on the standalone terminal. Saving the terminal settings below keeps manual card mode active. Turn off Use manual card payment and save payment methods to use Credit/Debit Card.

data.name: dailyClose.history.selectHint
data.value: Select a daily close record to view its details.

data.value: Select a denomination on the left to count it.

data.name: dailyClose.cashWorkspace.returnHistoryHint
data.value: Return to history and keep this draft.

data.value: No bank receipt for this record.

data.value: Linkly settlement is only available when the business date is today. Change the business date to {0:yyyy-MM-dd} and try again.

data.name: cardRecovery.v2.banner.squareRefund.body
data.value: The refund was sent to Square and is still being processed. No card tap is needed. The order completes once Square confirms.

data.name: cardRecovery.v2.banner.refund.body
data.value: Check the original refund result before refunding again by card or cash.

data.name: cardRecovery.v2.noProducts
data.value: No product snapshot was saved for this transaction.

data.name: cardRecovery.v2.auto.manualOnly
data.value: Tap Check status now to query the latest result.

data.name: cardRecovery.v2.sheet.outcomeHint
data.value: Choosing an outcome asks an authorised supervisor to scan their barcode.

data.name: cardRecovery.v2.sheet.audit
data.value: The decision is recorded in the audit log with the supervisor's name.

data.name: cardRecovery.v2.outcome.processed.refund
data.value: The refund reached the customer's card.

data.name: cardRecovery.v2.outcome.notProcessed.refund
data.value: No refund was made. The return stays open for a new refund.

data.name: cardRecovery.v2.outcome.notProcessed.sale
data.value: No charge was made. The order can be paid again.

data.name: cardRecovery.v2.outcome.waiting
data.value: Keep the transaction locked and check again later. A supervisor note is required.

data.name: payment.card.squareRefundAccepted
data.value: Square accepted the refund and is returning it to the original card. Most refunds complete within a few hours (up to 14 days). No card tap is needed.

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.pending
data.value: Square accepted this refund and is still settling it. No action is needed; the status updates automatically.

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.completed
data.value: Square completed the refund. The money is on its way to the customer's card.

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.rejected
data.value: Square did not complete this refund. Refund the customer by cash or another method, then confirm it here.

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.onlyAcknowledge
data.value: Square rejected this refund after the return was completed. Only "Refunded by other means" applies.

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.acknowledged
data.value: Recorded: the customer was refunded by other means.

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.acknowledgeFailed
data.value: The refund status changed. Refresh and try again.

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.banner.rejected.body
data.value: The customer has not received this money. Refund them by cash or another method, then tap "Refunded by other means".

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.banner.pending.title
data.value: The return is complete. Square is settling the refund.

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.banner.pending.body
data.value: Square accepted the refund and is sending it to the original card. Most refunds complete within a few hours (up to 14 days). No card tap is needed and no action is required.

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.instructions
data.value: Refund the customer by cash or another method first, then record it here. Optionally add a note, such as how much was paid and the receipt number.

data.name: cardRecovery.settlement.outcome.refundedOther
data.value: The customer was paid back by cash or another method.
